plain.li: The room's as warm as a hearth with {PET_nameDef} curled up in the corner.
Nobody's touched the heater since {PET_nameDef} took to sleeping in here.
I can feel the heat off {PET_nameDef} from across the room.
Best spot in the colony is wherever {PET_nameDef} is lying.
Cold out there, and toasty in here, thanks to {PET_nameDef}.
[named] Move over, {PET_nameDef}, I want some of that warmth.
[shiny] Even its odd colors look warm when it's curled up like that.

cheerful.li: Who needs a fire when you've got {PET_nameDef}?

gloomy.li: Warm enough in here, as long as {PET_nameDef} doesn't wander off.

plain.li: It's cooler in here with {PET_nameDef} about, and in this heat that's a mercy.
Frost on the sill in high summer, that'll be {PET_nameDef}.
Sleep next to {PET_nameDef} on a night like this and you'll thank me.
The heat isn't getting in here while {PET_nameDef} lies by the door.
You can almost see your breath near {PET_nameDef}, even now.
[named] Stay put, {PET_nameDef}, you're the only cool thing for miles.

cheerful.li: Come and stand by {PET_nameDef}, it's like a cellar in summer.

plain.li: The rows round {PET_nameDef} are coming up faster than the rest.
Whatever {PET_nameDef} does, the crops beside it love it.
Look how green it is where {PET_nameDef} lies down.
If {PET_nameDef} naps in the field again, we'll be harvesting early.
The plants lean toward {PET_nameDef} as if it were the sun.
[named] Good, {PET_nameDef}, lie there a while longer.

cold.li: The yield near {PET_nameDef} is measurably better.

plain.li: The battery's humming again, so {PET_nameDef} must be napping beside it.
Every time {PET_nameDef} leans on the battery, the needle creeps up.
Mind the sparks, {PET_nameDef} is charging the battery again.
Free power, as long as {PET_nameDef} likes sleeping there.
My hair stands up whenever I walk past {PET_nameDef} and that battery.
[named] Good, {PET_nameDef}, keep that battery company.

cold.li: It isn't much, but {PET_nameDef} is a cheaper generator than most.

plain.li: It's gone quiet in my head, thank you, {PET_nameDef}.
I was about to lose it, and then {PET_nameDef} looked at me.
Stay a moment, {PET_nameDef}, just a moment more.
How do you do that, {PET_nameDef}, make everything go still?
I can breathe again, all right, I can breathe.
[named] Thank you, {PET_nameDef}, I needed that.

gloomy.li: It won't last, but it's quiet for now.

plain.li: Look at {PET_nameDef} go, it's putting the fire out by itself.
Good, {PET_nameDef}, soak it all!
That fire never stood a chance with {PET_nameDef} next to it.
Steam everywhere and the flames going down, well done, {PET_nameDef}.
Keep at it, {PET_nameDef}, we're coming with the rest!
Somebody give {PET_nameDef} a medal for that fire.
Come on then, show me what those fists can do.
Easy on me today, {PET_nameDef}, I'm still sore from last time.
Right, {PET_nameDef}, guard up, and no biting.
One round, {PET_nameDef}, then we both rest.
You lead, and I'll try to keep up.
[named] Let's see if you've got any faster, {PET_nameDef}.
Ow, that one landed, {PET_nameDef}.
Steady, steady, you got me there.
That's going to bruise, good hit, {PET_nameDef}.
Hold on, hold on, I need a moment.
Fair enough, I never saw that one coming.
[named] Who taught you that one, {PET_nameDef}?

gloomy.li: Of course it was my bad side.

plain.li: Easy now, sit with me a while.
Look at me, {PET_nameDef}, and don't be afraid of the light.
Stay close, this won't hurt, I promise.
Hush now, and just breathe with me.
You can feel it too, can't you?
There you are, {PET_nameDef}, come here to me.

cold.li: Hold still, {PET_nameDef}, this takes an hour.

plain.li: There, we're bound now, you and I.
Can you feel me there, {PET_nameDef}?
You're glowing, {PET_nameDef}, did you know that?
Wherever you go now, I'll know.
It took, it actually took.
Welcome, familiar, I'm glad it's you.

warm.li: We'll look after each other now, {PET_nameDef}.

plain.li: No, no, {NAME}, I felt that.
Something just went out, and {NAME} is gone.
I can't feel {NAME} anymore, it's simply gone.
The magic's gone cold, so {NAME} is dead.
Where are you, {NAME}, where did you go?
It's as if a door slammed shut inside me.

cold.li: The bond is broken, and so am I, for now.

plain.li: I spent an hour with {PET_nameDef} today, and something passed between us. It's my familiar now. I can feel where it is with my eyes shut.
The binding took. {PET_nameDef} glows a little at night now, faint enough that only I notice, and the mana comes easier when it's near.
An hour of quiet, my hand on {PET_nameDef}'s back, and the light going back and forth between us. I've read about it all my life. It's nothing like the books.
It's bound to me now. I keep looking round to check {PET_nameDef} is still there, and it always is.
My familiar, at last. {PET_nameDef} didn't flinch once, even when the light came.
I thought binding a familiar would feel like casting. It felt more like making a friend.

cold.li: Bound {PET_nameDef} as a familiar. The mana returns faster near it, as expected.

plain.li: {NAME} died today. I felt it the moment it happened, like a candle going out behind me. The magic won't come.
My familiar is dead. I was halfway through a sentence when it happened, and I never finished it.
{NAME} is gone. The bond doesn't just break, it tears, and it takes the mana with it.
Everyone says I'll bind another one day. Maybe. Not yet. {NAME} was the one.
I keep reaching for {NAME} out of habit, and finding nothing there.
The healers can't mend what's wrong with me. It isn't a wound. It's {NAME}, gone.

cold.li: {NAME} is dead. The bond's loss cost me my mana and most of a day. I will recover.

plain.li: [sign:eclipse] Born while the sun went dark, so we'll call this one {PET_nameDef}.
[sign:eclipse] A little one of the eclipse, {PET_nameDef}, and that means something.
[sign:aurora] Born under the lights in the sky, welcome, {PET_nameDef}.
[sign:aurora] The whole sky was dancing when {PET_nameDef} came, that's luck.
[sign:shiny] Look at those colors, {PET_nameDef}, you're one in a thousand.
[sign:shiny] A shiny one born to us, and we'll call it {PET_nameDef}.
[sign:keptday] Born on {DAY} of all days, so it's {PET_nameDef}.
[sign:keptday] A little one on {DAY}, {PET_nameDef}, that has to mean something.
Born under a sign, this one, and its name is {PET_nameDef}.
Welcome, {PET_nameDef}, you came on a strange day.
[sign:eclipse] An eclipse birth, people will talk about that one for years.
[sign:aurora] Under the lights, of all things, that one's going to be lucky.
[sign:shiny] I've never seen colors like that on a newborn.
[sign:keptday] On {DAY}, too, you couldn't plan it better.
Mark it down, {OTHER_nameDef}, that's a sign if ever I saw one.
Lucky for all of us, I'd say.
My grandmother would have called that a blessing.

gloomy.li: Let's hope it's the good kind of sign.

plain.li: {NAME} is dead, and I don't like what that means.
Born under the sign, and now this, it's a bad omen.
[sign:eclipse] The eclipse's child, gone, and something's coming.
Nobody say it, but we're all thinking it.
Poor {NAME}, all that luck and it didn't last.
Cover it up, and don't let the children see.

cold.li: An animal died; it means nothing, whatever they say.

plain.li: [sign:eclipse] The sun went dark at midday, and the newborn came in the middle of it. I named it {PET_nameDef}. Everyone came to look.
[sign:aurora] There were lights across the whole sky tonight, green and red, and {PET_nameDef} was born under them. I named it myself.
[sign:shiny] The newborn came out in colors none of its kind has. One in a thousand, they say. I named it {PET_nameDef}.
[sign:keptday] Born on {DAY}, of all days. I named it {PET_nameDef}, and nobody argued.
A newborn under a sign, and I was the one who named it: {PET_nameDef}. The whole colony is talking.
I've raised animals all my life and never had one born like {PET_nameDef}. People keep stopping at the pen.

cold.li: Named the newborn {PET_nameDef}. The others think its birth means something. It is a healthy animal.

plain.li: [sign:eclipse] Umbra
[sign:eclipse] Shade
[sign:eclipse] Dusk
[sign:eclipse] Midnight
[sign:eclipse] Corona
[sign:aurora] Glimmer
[sign:aurora] Aurora
[sign:aurora] Ribbon
[sign:aurora] Skylight
[sign:aurora] Shimmer
[sign:shiny] Gleam
[sign:shiny] Sparkle
[sign:shiny] Penny
[sign:shiny] Glint
[sign:shiny] Luster
[sign:keptday] Feast
[sign:keptday] Holiday
[sign:keptday] Jubilee
[sign:keptday] Merry
[sign:keptday] Lucky
A sacred one, dead on our own land, and it shouldn't be.
The faith holds them sacred, and look at it, lying there.
Rest now, sacred one, I'm sorry it ended here.
Somebody should say the words over it.
Not one of these, never one of these.
We'll answer for this somehow, I know it.

cold.li: A sacred {KIND}, dead, and it's a poor sign for all of us.

plain.li: Someone's marked one of the sacred animals for the hunt, and I'll have no part of it.
Hunt a sacred one, they want, but not with my hands.
The faith says no, and I say no, so leave it be.
Whoever marked that animal can carry the guilt alone.
That's a sacred {KIND} out there, so take the mark off it.
I won't go near that hunt, and I'll tell anyone why.
